verdict.rationale: Paddle is a billing and payments platform, not an AI agent or MCP host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence only shows Paddle publishing its own MCP servers (the server role), which is a different story and does not make the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
